subject: general
question: Who was the chief drafter of Article 370?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N Gopalaswami Ayyangar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **N Gopalaswami Ayyangar** was a senior civil servant and a minister without portfolio in the first cabinet of India.
 
• He played a crucial role in the drafting of Article 370, which granted special autonomy to Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Before joining the central government, he served as the Prime Minister of Jammu and Kashmir under Maharaja Hari Singh.
 
• His deep understanding of the region's complexities was instrumental in shaping the policies related to Jammu and Kashmir's special status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 370**

 
 
• Article 370 of the Indian Constitution granted special autonomous status to Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The article was drafted in Part XXI of the Indian Constitution titled "Temporary, Transitional and Special Provisions".
 
• Under this article, the state's residents lived under a separate set of laws, including those related to citizenship, ownership of property, and fundamental rights, as compared to other Indians.
 
• Article 370 was abrogated on August 5, 2019, through a presidential order and the passage of a resolution in Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**
 
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the principal architect of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He was the chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Ambedkar played a key role in the formation of laws and policies to uplift the marginalized sections of society in India.
 
 
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri**
 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri served as the second Prime Minister of India.
 
• He is known for promoting the White Revolution – a national campaign to increase the production and supply of milk.
 
• He also led the country during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965.
 
 
 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel**
 
 
• Vallabhbhai Patel, also known as the "Iron Man of India," was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.
 
• He played a crucial role in the integration of the princely states into the Indian Union.
 
• Patel was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and a senior leader of the Indian National Congress.
